{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.5), pull forecasts toward mean-reversion by 10-15% of the sentiment strength to correct lag",
    "When sentiment is negative (≤0.33), forecasts are 2-3% too low - adjust upward by sentiment magnitude",
    "Model tends to overshoot current prices when volatility is high - compress 20-day forecast range by 15-25%",
    "When price has been flat (0 change) over 5+ days, forecasts are overly aggressive - flatten 30% of forecast deviation from current price",
    "Sentiment alignment rule: when sentiment flipped direction recently, forecast should move more slowly toward new sentiment value",
    "Underlying price trend bias: when history shows clear uptrend, model forecasts are 1-2 points too low; for downtrend, 1-2 points too high",
    "Sentiment momentum correction: if sentiment has been increasing for 3+ consecutive steps, reduce forecast response by 30%"
] }
